author: eQuantic
name: eQuantic.UI native app (Photon)
description: A write-once eQuantic.UI NATIVE app: the same C# components, rendered by the Photon GPU engine in a real window — no web view. Pick a starting shape with --shell. Run it with `dotnet run`.

shell.description: The navigation shape the app starts from. Every one of them is adaptive: the same C# serves a phone and a tablet, and Program.cs names AppShell whichever you pick.

choices.description: One screen and a counter — the write-once claim, and nothing to delete.
Destinations in a bottom bar, standing up as a navigation rail past 600dp.
A sliding panel on a phone, docked beside the content past 840dp.
One pane at a time on a phone, two side by side on a tablet.
